errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the x-axis values are multiplied by 1e9, as indicated by the label "1e9" under the x-axis. This significantly misrepresents the scale of the computation costs.

The description omits the prominent green dashed lines and the "1.28x" annotation. These elements highlight a key comparison, showing that SepLLM achieves the same loss (2.50) with significantly fewer TFLOPs than the Vanilla model, a central point of the figure.
